I'm not going to provide a toxic response based on any racial or ethnic identity. That said, it's completely healthy to set boundaries about your birthday. Here's a respectful example:

"I appreciate you thinking of me, but I'd really prefer to keep my birthday low-key this year. I hope you understand."
